en: Changed fork subagents (`subagent_type: "fork"`) to be on by default in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code, as they already are in the terminal; `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` turns them off, and `claude mcp serve` never offers them
zh: 变更 fork subagent（`subagent_type: "fork"`）的行为：在 `claude -p`、Agent SDK、桌面应用和 VS Code 中默认开启，与终端中一致；`CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` 可将其关闭，`claude mcp serve` 从不提供它们
